feature: Receipt PDF eService (printslip) untuk offender setelah bayar online
note: Generator PDF receipt (notice, vehicle, offence date, amount, payment mode, receipt no) hanya untuk offender di portal publik; mirip OCMS44.6 (Removed) tetapi bukan fitur officer. printslip dilewatkan tanpa JWT (JwtFilter.java:136). Tidak diklaim.
note_en: The PDF receipt generator (notice, vehicle, offence date, amount, payment mode, receipt no) is only for the offender in the public portal; similar to OCMS44.6 (Removed) but not an officer feature. printslip bypasses JWT (JwtFilter.java:136). Not claimed.

feature: Daily Paid Report (laporan harian pembayaran) dikirim lewat email
type: Kode tanpa story di chunk ini
note: Cron harian 08:00 (enabled=true) membuat workbook paid report per hari dan mengirimnya ke email.report.paymentreport.daily.recipients. OCMS44.7 hanya meminta weekly/monthly; apakah daily dicakup story lain (misalnya OCMS45.4) tidak diperiksa di chunk ini.
note_en: The daily cron at 08:00 (enabled=true) builds a daily paid report workbook and sends it to email.report.paymentreport.daily.recipients. OCMS44.7 only asks for weekly/monthly; whether another story covers daily (for example OCMS45.4) was not checked in this chunk.
